description: We are an online team with a background in AI and technology, looking for creative and passionate members to collaborate on the space challenges
summary: Our project, SPHEREx Streak Engine, develops a Probabilistic Quality Masking (PQM) system that reduces the influence of contaminated pixels when combining SPHEREx exposures, without changing the original science data. The system uses probabilistic masks to identify likely streaks and artifacts, then applies lower weights to those pixels during image integration. This approach aims to improve the reliability of SPHEREx time-series data while preserving the original measurements. The project includes a Streamlit-based viewer that displays SPHEREx exposures as a time-series blink sequence, helping users inspect changes across observations. Our work uses NASA SPHEREx data and SPARKLES metadata to build and evaluate the masking approach. The project is designed to support future improvements in streak detection and data quality assessment for SPHEREx observations.
